consultation-patient-requests-a-quote-fo.summary: Patient requests a quote for booking a consultation slot in a given doctor’s schedule

action.description: Defines the DHP API call. Any actions other than the enumerated actions are not supported by DHP Protocol

consumer_id.description: Unique id of the Consumer. By default it is the fully qualified domain name of the Consumer

consumer_uri.description: URI of the Consumer for accepting callbacks. Must have the same domain name as the consumer_id

core_version.description: Version of DHP core API specification being used

country.description: Country code as per ISO 3166-1 and ISO 3166-2 format

domain.description: Describes the domain of an object

key.description: The encryption public key of the sender

message_id.description: This is a unique value which persists during a request / callback cycle

provider_id.description: Unique id of the Provider. By default it is the fully qualified domain name of the Provider

provider_uri.description: URI of the Provider. Must have the same domain name as the provider_id

timestamp.description: Time of request generation in RFC3339 format

transaction_id.description: This is a unique value which persists across all API calls from search through confirm

ttl.description: The duration in ISO8601 format after timestamp for which this message holds valid

fulfillment_id.description: Unique reference ID to the fulfillment of an order

id.description: This is the most unique identifier of a service item. An example of an Item ID could be the SKU of a product.

measure.description: An object representing a scalar quantity.

requestBody.description: Selection of various products/services as part of order

code.description: DHP specific error code. For full list of error codes, refer to error_codes.md in the root folder of this repo

message.description: Human readable message describing the error

path.description: Path to json schema generating the error. Used only during json schema validation errors

status.description: ACK: the request was received. The answer arrives later on a callback.

servers.description: The HSPA's provider_uri, taken from context.provider_uri in its on_search.

spec.x-abdm-title: Select items and build an order
